description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton_c, a specialized widget extending SugarWidget, used to generate and manage top buttons in subpanels within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM interface. It includes methods for constructing the widget, generating HTML forms and buttons, handling related data, and integrating with ACL (Access Control List) checks.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton_c
classes.description: A subclass of SugarWidget that creates and manages buttons in subpanel top bars, specifically for the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. Handles button rendering, form creation, and relationship name determination.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes button properties based on provided parameters or a class details array.

methods.name: getWidgetId
methods.description: Generates a unique widget ID for the button, optionally with a suffix.

methods.name: _get_form
methods.description: Creates an HTML form or URL string for the button, optionally returning a URL instead of HTML.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the button or form, integrating ACL checks and handling special request cases.

methods.name: _create_json_encoded_popup_request
methods.description: Encodes popup request data as JSON.

methods.name: get_subpanel_relationship_name
methods.description: Determines the relationship name for a given subpanel definition based on its data source or module name.
